title: shadow-dollars
description: Replication package for the preprint "Shadow Dollars: Stablecoin Rails, Scam Finance and the Limits of Detection in Thailand": collectors for public on-chain (Coin Metrics), exchange-rate (Federal Reserve H.10), inflation (World Bank) and sanctions (OFAC SDN) data with a hashed manifest; event studies with placebo-calibrated inference; detectors for structuring (difference-in-bunching), pass-through speed (dwell-time mixtures), direction-aware graph exposure, anomaly scoring and synthetic control; and an agent-based exchange simulator with planted mule accounts used to validate them by Monte Carlo.
